environment.description: Same Terraform provider binary deployed in ECS Fargate. DATABASE_URL points to a PgBouncer 1.21 instance running in transaction pooling mode with server_prepared_statements=yes and disable_pqexec=1. PgBouncer is configured with a custom query_filter plugin (pgbouncer-rr fork) that enforces parameterized query patterns via allowlist regex: only queries matching '^(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE)\s+' with '$N' parameter placeholders pass through. Additionally, the ECS task role has a permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/TFProviderBoundary) that denies logs:PutLogEvents for any log group not matching '/ecs/tf-provider/*', and the container runs with a read-only root filesystem with /tmp mounted as noexec tmpfs. The PgBouncer max_client_conn=50 with reserve_pool_size=0 enforces strict connection limits.

config.network: ALB with no WAF (L7 routing only)
config.auth: IAM database authentication via RDS Proxy token rotation
